title: tasknotes.settings 1.0.0
description: Collection-wide behaviour that every TaskNotes client honours. Every field is optional and has a default, so a record with none of them behaves like no record at all.

app.description: Marks this record as TaskNotes' settings.

scope.description: These settings apply to everyone using TaskNotes in this collection.

settings_version.description: The version of these settings that last wrote the record. TaskNotes writes 1.

nlp_triggers.description: Natural-language capture triggers, such as @ for contexts. Without the field each client uses its own defaults.

template_enabled.description: Apply template_path to the body of new tasks.

template_path.description: The template for new task bodies. Empty or absent means none.

occurrence_template_enabled.description: Apply occurrence_template_path to new materialized occurrences.

occurrence_template_path.description: The template for new occurrence bodies. Empty or absent means none.

template_failure_mode.description: What a client does when a template cannot be applied.

template_unknown_variable_policy.description: What a client writes for a template variable it does not know.

move_on_archive.description: Move a task's file to archive_folder when it is archived.

archive_folder.description: Where archived tasks move to. Empty or absent means the client's default.

auto_stop_time_tracking_on_complete.description: Stop a running timer when its task is completed.

reset_body_checkboxes_on_recurrence.description: Uncheck body checkboxes when a recurring task moves to its next occurrence.

link_write_format.description: How clients write links into task frontmatter. Both formats are always read.

status_behavior.description: Behaviour per status value. A status without an entry has no next status and no auto-archive, and is out of the status cycle exactly when it is a skipped status.

next_status.description: The status the cycle moves to next.

exclude_from_cycle.description: Leave this status out of the status cycle.

auto_archive.description: Archive a task some time after it takes this status.

auto_archive_delay_minutes.description: How long after taking this status a task is archived.
